+        f"# {change_id}",
+        "",
+        "## Why",
+        "",
+        why.strip(),
+        "",
+        "## What Changes",
+        "",
+        what.strip(),
+        "",
+        "## Context",
+        "",
+        context.strip() or "Collected by the SpecRunway onboarding wizard.",
+        "",
+        "## Goals/Non-Goals",
+        "",
+        f"- Goals: {acceptance.strip()}",
+        "- Non-Goals: deferred to the manifest and later planning content.",
+        "",
+        "## Tasks",
+        "",
+    ]
+    for repo_id, tasks in tasks_by_repo.items():
+        lines.append(f"### {repo_id}")
+        for task_id, text in tasks:
+            lines.append(f"{task_id}: {text}")
+        lines.append("")
+    return "\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n"
+
+
+def build_manifest(
+    *,
+    config: dict,
+    change_id: str,
+    tasks_by_repo: dict,
+    base_refs: dict,
+    allowed_paths: dict,
+    depends_on: dict,
+    acceptance: str,
+) -> dict:
+    profiles = config.get("test_profiles") or {}
+    integration_profiles = config.get("integration_profiles") or {}
+    integration_profile = next(iter(integration_profiles), DEFAULT_INTEGRATION_PROFILE)
+    if integration_profile not in integration_profiles:
+        raise ValidationError(
+            "integration-profile-missing",
+            "local.yaml declares no integration profile; run `specrunway wizard --reconfigure`",
+        )
+    repos = []
+    all_tasks: list = []
+    for repo_id in config["repos"]:
+        tasks = tasks_by_repo[repo_id]
+        all_tasks.extend(task_id for task_id, _text in tasks)
+        profile = f"{repo_id}-unit" if f"{repo_id}-unit" in profiles else "unit"
+        repos.append(
+            {
+                "repo_id": repo_id,
+                "base_ref": base_refs[repo_id],
+                "task_ids": [task_id for task_id, _text in tasks],
+                "depends_on": depends_on[repo_id],
+                "allowed_paths": allowed_paths[repo_id],
+                "test_profile": profile,
+            }
+        )
+    manifest = {
+        "api_version": "specrunway/v1",
+        "store_uid": spec_uid(str(Path(config["store"]["path"]).resolve())),
+        "change_id": change_id,
+        "change_uid": spec_uid(change_id),
+        "repo_order": list(config["repos"]),
+        "repos": repos,
+        "acceptance": [
+            {"id": "AC01", "requirement": acceptance.strip(), "verifies": all_tasks}
+        ],
+        "integration_profile": integration_profile,
+        "completion_policy": "merged_commits",
+        "budget": {
+            "repo_max_attempts": 3,
+            "integration_max_repairs": 2,
+            "total_minutes": 120,
+        },
+    }
+    validate_manifest(
+        manifest,
+        known_profiles=set(profiles) | {"unit"},
+    )
+    return manifest
+
+
+def _confirm_overwrite(paths: list, io: WizardIO, force: bool) -> None:
+    existing = [str(path) for path in paths if Path(path).exists()]
+    if (
+        existing
+        and not force
+        and not io.confirm("Replace existing " + ", ".join(existing) + "?", default=False)
+    ):
+        raise ValidationError(
+            "wizard-overwrite-declined", "existing artifacts were not replaced"
+        )
+
+
+def run_wizard(
+    control_root: Path,
+    *,
+    io: WizardIO | None = None,
+    reconfigure: bool = False,
+    change_id: str | None = None,
+    description: str | None = None,
+    request_path: Path | str | None = None,
+    manifest_path: Path | str | None = None,
+    skip_init: bool = False,
+    skip_plan: bool = False,
+    force: bool = False,
+) -> dict:
+    """Run configuration then request phases and hand off to ``plan``."""
+    from .bootstrap import initialize_control
+
+    root = Path(control_root).expanduser().resolve()
+    if not root.is_dir():
+        raise ValidationError("wizard-root-missing", f"control root does not exist: {root}")
+    wizard = io or WizardIO()
+    config_path = root / "local.yaml"
+    config_created = False
+
+    if reconfigure or not config_path.is_file():
+        if not config_path.is_file():
+            wizard.say(f"No local.yaml found; using {root} as the control checkout.")
+        config = collect_local_config(root, wizard)
+        _write_config(config_path, config, wizard, force)
+        config_created = True
+    else:
+        config = load_local_config(root)
+        wizard.say(f"Using existing control configuration: {config_path}")
+
+    initialized = None
+    if not skip_init:
+        initialized = initialize_control(root, config)
+        wizard.say("Control checkout initialized (Store, Specify workspace, bundled step).")
+
+    generated_request: Path | None = None
+    generated_manifest: Path | None = None
+    if request_path is not None:
+        generated_request = Path(request_path).expanduser()
+        if not generated_request.is_absolute():
+            generated_request = root / generated_request
+        generated_request = generated_request.resolve()
+        if not generated_request.is_file():
+            raise ValidationError(
+                "wizard-request-missing", f"request file does not exist: {generated_request}"
+            )
+        if change_id is None:
+            change_id = slugify(generated_request.stem)
+        if manifest_path is not None:
+            generated_manifest = Path(manifest_path).expanduser()
+            if not generated_manifest.is_absolute():
+                generated_manifest = root / generated_manifest
+            generated_manifest = generated_manifest.resolve()
+    elif skip_plan:
+        change_id = change_id or ""
+    else:
+        description = description or wizard.ask("Change summary")
+        if change_id is None:
+            change_id = slugify(description)
+        while not is_slug(change_id):
+            wizard.say("Change id must be a lowercase slug.")
+            change_id = wizard.ask("Change id", default=slugify(description))
+        why = wizard.ask("Why is this needed?", default=f"Implement: {description}")
+        what = wizard.ask("What should change?", default=description)
+        context = wizard.ask("Additional context", required=False, allow_blank=True)
+        acceptance = wizard.ask(
+            "Acceptance criteria",
+            default=f"{description} is delivered with trusted verification.",
+        )
+        tasks_by_repo, base_refs, allowed, depends = collect_change_inputs(
+            config, description, wizard
+        )
+        generated_request = root / "requests" / f"{change_id}.md"
+        generated_manifest = (
+            root / ".specrunway" / "requests" / f"{change_id}.manifest.yaml"
+        )
+        _confirm_overwrite([generated_request, generated_manifest], wizard, force)
+        atomic_write_text(
+            generated_request,
+            render_request(
+                change_id=change_id,
+                why=why,
+                what=what,
+                context=context,
+                acceptance=acceptance,
+                tasks_by_repo=tasks_by_repo,
+            ),
+        )
+        manifest = build_manifest(
+            config=config,
+            change_id=change_id,
+            tasks_by_repo=tasks_by_repo,
+            base_refs=base_refs,
+            allowed_paths=allowed,
+            depends_on=depends,
+            acceptance=acceptance,
+        )
+        atomic_write_text(
+            generated_manifest, yaml.safe_dump(manifest, sort_keys=False)
+        )
+        wizard.say(f"Wrote request: {generated_request}")
+        wizard.say(f"Wrote routing manifest: {generated_manifest}")
+
+    result: dict = {
+        "control_root": str(root),
+        "config_path": str(config_path),
+        "config_created": config_created,
+        "request_path": str(generated_request) if generated_request else None,
+        "manifest_path": str(generated_manifest) if generated_manifest else None,
+        "change_id": change_id or "",
+        "planned": False,
+        "next": [],
+    }
+    if initialized is not None:
+        result["specify_initialized"] = initialized["specify_initialized"]
+        result["step_package"] = initialized["step_package"]
+
+    if skip_plan:
+        return result
+    if generated_request is None:
+        raise ValidationError("wizard-request-missing", "no request file was produced")
+
+    outcome = plan(
+        control_root=root,
+        store_id=config["store"]["id"],
+        change_id=change_id or "",
+        request_path=generated_request,
+        manifest_path=generated_manifest,
+    )
+    result.update(
+        {
+            "planned": True,
+            "change_id": outcome.change_id,
+            "change_path": outcome.change_path,
+            "planning_complete": outcome.planning_complete,
+            "task_ids": outcome.task_ids,
+            "generated": outcome.generated,
+            "next": [
+                f"specrunway run --change {outcome.change_id}",
+                "specrunway approve --execution <id> --kind plan --actor <you>",
+                "specrunway run --execution <id> --continue",
+            ],
+        }
+    )
+    return result
+
+

+    subprocess.run(

# SpecRunway v1 runbook (local coordinator)

Reproducible local operation of the Central Store Coordinator at pinned
tool versions (OpenSpec 1.14.3, specify-cli 1.2.1, Python 3.14, one real
coding-agent CLI). No server, database, broker, or team component is used.

## 1. Install

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install specrunway-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl   # or: pip install .
.venv/bin/specrunway --version
.venv/bin/python -m pip install "specify-cli @ git+https://github.com/github/spec-kit.git@v1.2.1"
```

The OpenSpec CLI is pinned by `tooling/openspec/package.json`; install it
with `npm ci --prefix tooling/openspec`.

## 2. Control checkout

`local.yaml` lives only in the control checkout (never in business repos):

```yaml
store:
  id: my-store
  path: /abs/path/to/store          # OpenSpec Store repository
repos:
  repo-a:
    path: /abs/path/to/repo-a       # existing Git checkout
    remote_identity: https://example.org/repo-a.git
agent_profile: primary-coding-agent
max_workers: 1
test_profiles:                     # trusted argv per manifest test_profile
  go-unit:
    command: ["go", "test", "./..."]
    cwd: cloudevents-server        # relative to the repo worktree
  k8s-validate:
    command: ["bash", "scripts/validate_k8s_yaml.sh"]

integration_profiles:              # executable combined check, trusted config
  quota-e2e:
    command: ["go", "test", "./test/e2e/..."]
    repo: operator                 # worktree to run from (default: first repo)
    timeout_seconds: 900
```

```bash
specrunway init --json     # Store setup + Specify workspace + bundled step
specrunway doctor --json   # wiring findings, exit 1 on errors
```

`init` is idempotent, creates the Store directory, registers the Store,
initializes `.specify` only when absent, installs the `specrunway` step from
the installed package, and never writes outside the control checkout. You do
not need to type the upstream `openspec`/`specify` commands yourself.

## 3. Plan

```bash
specrunway plan my-change --store my-store --request request.md --json
```

- Generates proposal/design/tasks/spec deltas in the Store when the change
  is new; accepts an existing complete manual plan otherwise.
- Task routing comes from the manifest (`task_ids`, `depends_on`,
  `allowed_paths`, `test_profile`). Forward dependencies, unknown repos,
  duplicate/missing tasks, and unknown profiles fail before execution.
- Planning success is NOT implementation completion; checkboxes stay
  unchecked.

## 4. Run and approve

```bash
specrunway run --change my-change --json          # freezes snapshot + starts native run
specrunway approve --execution <id> --kind plan --actor <you> --json
specrunway resume --execution <id> --json         # or: specrunway run --execution <id> --continue
specrunway status --execution <id> --json
```

Execution order:

1. `prepare` → ordered repos from `repo_order`.
2. Native plan gate pauses until a matching `self_asserted` receipt exists;
   `resume` re-checks the receipt and the live planning digest before
   supplying the native verdict.
3. `run-repo` fan-out with `max_concurrency: 1`: per-repo worktree at the
   frozen base OID, bounded prompt, agent CLI (argv only), trusted tests,
   result identity/ancestry/path validation, result + receipt persistence.
4. `verify-round` re-runs trusted tests; `repair-round` retries only failing
   repos with prior test feedback, bounded by `repo_max_attempts`. Test
   profiles are frozen from `test_profiles` in the snapshot (`command`, `cwd`,
   `timeout_seconds`, digest); editing `local.yaml` later does not change a
   running execution.
5. `integration-round` writes `matrix.json` (accepted head/result per repo),
   exports `SPECRUNWAY_MATRIX` + `SPECRUNWAY_HEAD_<REPO>`, and runs the frozen
   integration command. Failure is fed back to the last repository and
   retried within `integration_max_repairs`; a repeated failure at the same
   matrix head stops as `no-progress`. `ready_for_review` requires a passed
   receipt bound to the current matrix.
6. `accept-tasks` flips only the mapped tasks.md checkboxes (single writer).
7. Native implementation gate pauses for the implementation approval bound
   to the accepted-results digest; after approval `resume` completes at
   `ready_for_review`.

## 5. Failure handling

| Situation | Command | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Gate pause | `specrunway resume` | Checks receipt + digests, resumes native run |
| Retryable native failure | `specrunway resume` | Native resume; completed steps are not re-run |
| Blocked budget/no-progress | — | `specrunway status` shows `blocked`; preserve worktrees for takeover |
| Orphan `running`, owner dead | `specrunway recover` | Old run preserved `abandoned-running`, new native run same execution, verified receipts reused |
| Orphan `running`, owner alive | — | `specrunway recover` refuses `orphan-alive`; stop the process first |
| Archive outcome unknown | `specrunway recover` | Path-based reconciliation records the proven result; mixed state stays blocked |

Counters (`budgets`), accepted results, verification rows, and operation
intents/receipts live in `<control>/.specrunway/runs/<execution>/` and survive
process restarts. Never edit Specify's private run state.

## 6. Archive

```bash
specrunway archive --execution <id> --json                             # merged_commits (default)
specrunway archive --execution <id> --policy validated_commits \
            --confirm-validated --json                          # reviewed commits only
```

Preflight blocks when: phase is not `ready_for_review`, results are not
accepted/verified, mapped tasks remain unchecked, the implementation
approval no longer binds the results, final trusted tests fail or run at a
different head, or `merged_commits` finds an accepted head not merged into
the base ref (`partial-merge`). `validated_commits` requires explicit
selection plus `--confirm-validated` and never claims a main-branch merge.

Archive writes intent + backup before applying OpenSpec deltas, verifies the
resulting path/specs, and records a receipt. A successful archive is never
replayed. Backup: `<control>/.specrunway/runs/<execution>/archive-backup/<stamp>/`
(`change/` tree, `before.json`, `after.json`).

Restore drill: copy `archive-backup/<stamp>/change` back to the Store change

def _control_root_for(args: argparse.Namespace) -> Path | None:
    return Path(args.root).resolve() if args.root else find_control_root(Path.cwd())


def cmd_init(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    """Idempotent control bootstrap: Store, Specify workspace, bundled step."""
    import subprocess

    from specrunway.models import load_local_config
    from specrunway.openspec_adapter import OpenSpecAdapter
    from specrunway.toolresolvers import resolve_tool_bin

    root = _control_root_for(args)
    if root is None:
        return _fail_cli(
            _error_envelope(
                "init",
                RuntimeError("no control checkout found; pass --root or run inside it"),
            ),
            args.json,
            "specrunway init",
        )
    try:

    except FileNotFoundError:
        return _fail_cli(
            _error_envelope(
                "init",
                _validation_error(
                    "local-yaml-missing",
                    f"write {root / 'local.yaml'} (store, repos, agent_profile, "
                    "integration_profiles) before running init",
                ),
            ),
            args.json,
            "specrunway init",
        )
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return _fail_cli(_error_envelope("init", exc), args.json, "specrunway init")
    specify_initialized = False
    try:
        openspec_bin = resolve_tool_bin(root, None, "openspec")
        specify_bin = resolve_tool_bin(root, None, "specify")
        store_path = Path(config["store"]["path"])
        store_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        adapter = OpenSpecAdapter(
            store_path=store_path,
            store_id=config["store"]["id"],
            openspec_bin=openspec_bin,
        )
        adapter.store_setup()
        if not (root / ".specify").is_dir():

                [
                    specify_bin,
                    "init",
                    "--here",
                    "--force",
                    "--non-interactive",
                    "--ignore-agent-tools",

def cmd_init(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    """Idempotent control bootstrap: Store, Specify workspace, bundled step."""
    import subprocess

    from specrunway.models import load_local_config
    from specrunway.openspec_adapter import OpenSpecAdapter
    from specrunway.toolresolvers import resolve_tool_bin

    root = _control_root_for(args)
    if root is None:
        return _fail_cli(
            _error_envelope(
                "init",
                RuntimeError("no control checkout found; pass --root or run inside it"),
            ),
            args.json,
            "specrunway init",
        )
    try:
        config = load_local_config(root)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return _fail_cli(
            _error_envelope(
                "init",
                _validation_error(
                    "local-yaml-missing",
                    f"write {root / 'local.yaml'} (store, repos, agent_profile, "
                    "integration_profiles) before running init",
                ),
            ),
            args.json,
            "specrunway init",
        )
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return _fail_cli(_error_envelope("init", exc), args.json, "specrunway init")
    specify_initialized = False
    try:
        openspec_bin = resolve_tool_bin(root, None, "openspec")
        specify_bin = resolve_tool_bin(root, None, "specify")
        store_path = Path(config["store"]["path"])
        store_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        adapter = OpenSpecAdapter(
            store_path=store_path,
            store_id=config["store"]["id"],
            openspec_bin=openspec_bin,
        )
        adapter.store_setup()
        if not (root / ".specify").is_dir():
            done = subprocess.run(
                [
                    specify_bin,
                    "init",
                    "--here",
                    "--force",
                    "--non-interactive",
                    "--ignore-agent-tools",
                ],
                cwd=str(root),
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                check=False,
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            )
            if done.returncode != 0:
                raise _validation_error(
                    "specify-init-failed",
                    f"specify init failed (exit {done.returncode}): "
                    f"{(done.stderr or done.stdout)[-400:]}",
                )
            specify_initialized = True
        step_path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "step_package"
        installed_step = root / ".specify" / "workflows" / "steps" / "specrunway" / "step.yml"
        step = None
        if not installed_step.is_file():
            step = subprocess.run(
                [
                    specify_bin,
                    "workflow",
                    "step",
                    "add",
                    "specrunway",
                    "--dev",
                    str(step_path),
                ],
                cwd=str(root),
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                check=False,
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            )
        if step is not None and step.returncode != 0:
            raise _validation_error(
                "step-install-failed",
                f"specify step install failed (exit {step.returncode}): "
                f"{(step.stderr or step.stdout)[-400:]}",
            )
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return _fail_cli(_error_envelope("init", exc), args.json, "specrunway init")

    report = run_doctor(root_dir=str(root))
    payload = _specrunway_envelope(
        action="init",
        ok=bool(report["ok"]),
        data={
            "control_root": str(root),
            "store_id": config["store"]["id"],
            "store_path": config["store"]["path"],
            "specify_initialized": specify_initialized,
            "step_package": str(step_path),
            "doctor_ok": bool(report["ok"]),
            "findings": report["data"]["findings"],
        },
        warnings=[],
    )
    if not report["ok"]:
        payload["error"] = {
            "code": "doctor-failed",
            "message": "init completed but doctor reported errors; fix them before plan/run",
            "retryable": False,
        }
    _emit(
        payload,
        args.json,
        f"init {'ok' if report['ok'] else 'incomplete'}: {root} "
        f"(store {config['store']['id']}, specify "
        f"{'initialized' if specify_initialized else 'already present'})\n",
    )
    return 0 if report["ok"] else 1

def _section(text: str, name: str, *, fallback: str) -> str:
    match = re.search(
        rf"^#+\s*{re.escape(name)}\s*$\n(?P<body>.*?)(?=^#+\s|\Z)",
        text,
        re.MULTILINE | re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
    )
    if match:
        body = match.group("body").strip()
        if body:
            return body
    return fallback


def _write_spec_deltas(
    change_path: Path, request_text: str, manifest: dict, generated: list
) -> None:
    """Scaffold one capability delta per repo (request may override via Spec blocks)."""
    capability_blocks = _parse_spec_blocks(request_text)
    shared = next(iter(capability_blocks.values()), None)
    spec_root = change_path / "specs"
    spec_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for repo in manifest["repos"]:
        block = shared or {
            "title": f"{repo['repo_id']} delivery",
            "body": "The requested capability SHALL complete with trusted verification.",
            "scenario_title": f"{repo['repo_id']} tasks accepted",
            "when": "the implementation completes in a separate worktree",
            "then": "the tasks attach to accepted commit evidence",
        }
        target = spec_root / f"{repo['repo_id']}-delivery"
        target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (target / "spec.md").write_text(
            f"# {target.name} Specification\n\n"
            "## ADDED Requirements\n\n"
            f"### Requirement: {block['title']}\n\n"
            f"{block['body']}\n\n"
            f"#### Scenario: {block['scenario_title']}\n\n"
            f"- **WHEN** {block['when']}\n"
            f"- **THEN** {block['then']}\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        generated.append(f"specs/{target.name}/spec.md")


def _parse_spec_blocks(text: str) -> dict:
    blocks: dict = {}
    pattern = re.compile(
        r"^Spec-Head:\s*(?P<capability>[a-z0-9-]+)\s*$\n"
        r"^Spec-Title:\s*(?P<title>.+?)\s*$\n"
        r"^Spec-Body:\s*(?P<body>.+?)\s*$\n"
        r"^Spec-When:\s*(?P<when>.+?)\s*$\n"
        r"^Spec-Then:\s*(?P<then>.+?)\s*$",
        re.MULTILINE,
    )
    for match in pattern.finditer(text):
        blocks[match.group("capability")] = {
            "title": match.group("title"),
            "body": match.group("body"),
            "scenario_title": f"{match.group('title')} accepted",
            "when": match.group("when"),
            "then": match.group("then"),
        }
    return blocks

import subprocess

import yaml

from specrunway.models.common import ErrorCollector, GroupedValidationError, is_slug

    "store",
    "repos",
    "agent_profile",
    "max_workers",
    "integration_profiles",
    "test_profiles",
}
INTEGRATION_PROFILE_KEYS = {"command", "repo", "timeout_seconds"}
TEST_PROFILE_KEYS = {"command", "cwd", "timeout_seconds"}
STORE_KEYS = {"id", "path"}
REPO_ENTRY_KEYS = {"path", "remote_identity"}


def validate_local_config(config: dict) -> dict:
    """Shape-validate local.yaml content (no filesystem side effects)."""
    err = ErrorCollector()
    if not isinstance(config, dict):
        err.fail("local-type", "local.yaml content must be a YAML mapping")
        raise GroupedValidationError(err.errors)
    unknown = set(config) - LOCAL_KEYS
    err.require(not unknown, "unknown-key", f"unknown local.yaml keys: {sorted(unknown)}")

    store = config.get("store")
    if not isinstance(store, dict):
        err.fail("store-type", "store must be a mapping")
    else:
        err.push_base("store")
        store_unknown = set(store) - STORE_KEYS
        err.require(
            not store_unknown, "unknown-key", f"store has unknown keys: {sorted(store_unknown)}"
        )
        err.require(is_slug(store.get("id")), "store-id", "store.id must be a slug")
        path = store.get("path")
        err.require(
            isinstance(path, str) and bool(Path(path.strip()).is_absolute()),
            "store-path",
            "store.path must be an absolute path (resolve relative paths at load time)",
        )
        err.pop_base()
    agent_profile = config.get("agent_profile")
    err.require(
        isinstance(agent_profile, str) and bool(agent_profile.strip()),
        "agent-profile",
        "agent_profile must be a non-empty string",
    )
    max_workers = config.get("max_workers", 1)
    if max_workers != 1:
        err.require(
            False,
            "not-supported-in-v1",
            "v1 runs one execution per control/Store checkout; max_workers must be 1",
        )
    repos = config.get("repos")
    if not isinstance(repos, dict) or not repos:
        err.fail("repos-type", "repos must be a non-empty mapping of repo_id -> entry")
    else:
        err.push_base("repos")
        for repo_id, entry in repos.items():
            err.push_base(str(repo_id))
            if not is_slug(str(repo_id)):
                err.require(False, "repo-id-format", f"repo key {repo_id!r} is not a slug")
            if not isinstance(entry, dict):
                err.fail("repo-entry-type", "repo entry must be a mapping")
                err.pop_base()
                continue
            entry_unknown = set(entry) - REPO_ENTRY_KEYS
            err.require(
                not entry_unknown,
                "unknown-key",
                f"repo {repo_id!r} has unknown keys: {sorted(entry_unknown)}",
            )
            repo_path = entry.get("path")
            err.require(
                isinstance(repo_path, str) and bool(Path(repo_path.strip()).is_absolute()),
                "repo-path",
                f"repo {repo_id!r} path must be absolute",
            )
            identity = entry.get("remote_identity")
            err.require(
                isinstance(identity, str) and bool(identity.strip()),
                "remote-identity",
                f"repo {repo_id!r} remote_identity must be a non-empty string",
            )
            if isinstance(identity, str) and identity.strip():
                host, id_path = normalize_identity(identity)
                err.require(
                    bool(host) and bool(id_path),
                    "remote-identity",
                    f"repo {repo_id!r} remote_identity {identity!r} is not a parseable "
                    "form (github:owner/repo, https://host/path, git@host:path)",
                )
            err.pop_base()
    profiles = config.get("integration_profiles")
    if profiles is not None:
        err.require(
            isinstance(profiles, dict),
            "integration-profiles-type",
            "integration_profiles must be a mapping of profile name -> entry",
        )
        if isinstance(profiles, dict):
            err.push_base("integration_profiles")
            for name, entry in profiles.items():
                err.push_base(str(name))
                err.require(
                    is_slug(str(name)),
                    "integration-profile-name",
                    f"integration profile {name!r} is not a slug",
                )
                if not isinstance(entry, dict):
                    err.fail("integration-profile-type", "profile entry must be a mapping")
                    err.pop_base()
                    continue
                unknown = set(entry) - INTEGRATION_PROFILE_KEYS
                err.require(
                    not unknown,
                    "unknown-key",
                    f"integration profile {name!r} has unknown keys: {sorted(unknown)}",
                )
                command = entry.get("command")
                err.require(
                    isinstance(command, list)
                    and len(command) > 0
                    and all(isinstance(part, str) and part.strip() for part in command),
                    "integration-command",
                    "command must be a non-empty argv list of strings",
                )
                repo = entry.get("repo")
                if repo is not None:
                    err.require(
                        isinstance(repo, str) and is_slug(repo),
                        "integration-repo",
                        "repo must be a repository id slug",
                    )
                timeout = entry.get("timeout_seconds")
                if timeout is not None:
                    err.require(
                        isinstance(timeout, int)
                        and not isinstance(timeout, bool)
                        and timeout > 0,
                        "integration-timeout",
                        "timeout_seconds must be a positive integer",
                    )
                err.pop_base()
            err.pop_base()
    test_profiles = config.get("test_profiles")
    if test_profiles is not None:
        err.require(
            isinstance(test_profiles, dict),
            "test-profiles-type",
            "test_profiles must be a mapping of profile name -> entry",
        )
        if isinstance(test_profiles, dict):
            err.push_base("test_profiles")
            for name, entry in test_profiles.items():
                err.push_base(str(name))
                err.require(
                    is_slug(str(name)),
                    "test-profile-name",
                    f"test profile {name!r} is not a slug",
                )
                if not isinstance(entry, dict):
                    err.fail("test-profile-type", "profile entry must be a mapping")
                    err.pop_base()
                    continue
                unknown = set(entry) - TEST_PROFILE_KEYS
                err.require(
                    not unknown,
                    "unknown-key",
                    f"test profile {name!r} has unknown keys: {sorted(unknown)}",
                )
                command = entry.get("command")
                err.require(
                    isinstance(command, list)
                    and len(command) > 0
                    and all(isinstance(part, str) and part.strip() for part in command),
                    "test-command",
                    "command must be a non-empty argv list of strings",
                )
                cwd = entry.get("cwd")
                if cwd is not None:
                    text = str(cwd)
                    parts = [
                        p for p in text.replace("\\", "/").split("/") if p not in ("", ".")
                    ]
                    err.require(
                        isinstance(cwd, str)
                        and not text.startswith(("/", "\\"))
                        and ".." not in parts,
                        "test-cwd",
                        "cwd must be a relative path inside the worktree",
                    )
                timeout = entry.get("timeout_seconds")
                if timeout is not None:
                    err.require(
                        isinstance(timeout, int)
                        and not isinstance(timeout, bool)
                        and timeout > 0,
                        "test-timeout",
                        "timeout_seconds must be a positive integer",
                    )
                err.pop_base()
            err.pop_base()
    if err.errors:
        raise GroupedValidationError(err.errors)
    return config


def load_local_config(control_root: Path) -> dict:
    """Load and validate control checkout local.yaml, resolving relative paths."""

Decision date: 19 October 2026. These decisions supplement the revision 2 design exported below.

| ID | Decision | Consequence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D01 | Central Store and cross-repository changes remain essential | Preserve routing, dependency commits, global verification and archive coordination |

| D06 | Bootstrap with upstream tools directly | Product self-hosting is unnecessary for initial development |
| D07 | Keep portable business contracts and replaceable execution | Product business state does not depend on private engine state layout |

| D10 | Rename the pre-release product to **SpecRunway** (20 October 2026, supersedes D08) | CLI `specrunway`, Python package `specrunway`, schema `specrunway/v1`, control directory `.specrunway/`, workflow step type `specrunway`, step package `tooling/specrunwaystep`. Full rename with no compatibility shims: v1 has not shipped, stored runs are disposable fixtures, and mixed identifiers would be worse than a clean break. ## Source of truth

The current change's requirements define intended observable behavior; its design defines implementation choices. `docs/DESIGN.md` supplies the full architecture, and `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md` maps stable source task IDs to changes. `tasks.md` in the active OpenSpec change owns implementation progress. `docs/ACCEPTANCE.md` owns verification status/evidence. The older Excel file is a reference snapshot, not a second live tracker.

When a material requirement conflict appears, record the resolution here and update the affected requirements before coding. Do not silently relax a failed requirement or turn a missing integration into a successful mock-only claim.

## Development change versus product change

The five prepared OpenSpec changes build this software. Their completion and archive affect this repository's specification baseline. The future product will operate on a user's separately registered central Store and business repositories. Keep test fixtures, root selection, run IDs, approvals, and archive operations scoped to the correct layer.

- Stage: L0 Compatibility; estimate: 1 person-days; dependencies: None.

# Confirmed implementation decisions

Decision date: 19 October 2026. These decisions supplement the revision 2 design exported below.

| ID | Decision | Consequence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D01 | Central Store and cross-repository changes remain essential | Preserve routing, dependency commits, global verification and archive coordination |
| D02 | Build local v1 first; team v2 later | No team service dependency or v2 implementation in the required v1 sequence |
| D03 | Exclude Specstride from current implementation | No installation, adapter, integration experiment, or mandatory comparison |
| D04 | Prefer Specify workflow as runtime | Prove the released custom-step, gate, loop and recovery contracts in L01 |
| D05 | Use OpenSpec to manage this repository's development | Maintain one set of proposal/spec/design/tasks artifacts for each change |
| D06 | Bootstrap with upstream tools directly | Product self-hosting is unnecessary for initial development |
| D07 | Keep portable business contracts and replaceable execution | Product business state does not depend on private engine state layout |
| D08 | ~~Preserve provisional `hub` / `hub/v1` identifiers~~ Superseded by D10 | Historical: the pre-release names were provisional |
| D09 | English files; no PDF deliverable | Repository-readable Markdown is the primary code-agent handoff |
| D10 | Rename the pre-release product to **SpecRunway** (20 October 2026, supersedes D08) | CLI `specrunway`, Python package `specrunway`, schema `specrunway/v1`, control directory `.specrunway/`, workflow step type `specrunway`, step package `tooling/specrunwaystep`. Full rename with no compatibility shims: v1 has not shipped, stored runs are disposable fixtures, and mixed identifiers would be worse than a clean break. Historical L01 probe fixtures keep their original `hub` text because they record what upstream was invoked with at that time; future replays use the new names. |
 

## Source of truth

The current change's requirements define intended observable behavior; its design defines implementation choices. `docs/DESIGN.md` supplies the full architecture, and `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md` maps stable source task IDs to changes. `tasks.md` in the active OpenSpec change owns implementation progress. `docs/ACCEPTANCE.md` owns verification status/evidence. The older Excel file is a reference snapshot, not a second live tracker.

When a material requirement conflict appears, record the resolution here and update the affected requirements before coding. Do not silently relax a failed requirement or turn a missing integration into a successful mock-only claim.

## Development change versus product change

The five prepared OpenSpec changes build this software. Their completion and archive affect this repository's specification baseline. The future product will operate on a user's separately registered central Store and business repositories. Keep test fixtures, root selection, run IDs, approvals, and archive operations scoped to the correct layer.

=== openspec/changes/archive/2026-10-20-07-one-command-bootstrap/design.md
# Design

## Context

Read `docs/DESIGN.md`, `docs/RUNBOOK.md`, the archived `local-project`
baseline, and this change's requirements. `specrunway plan` already performs
an idempotent OpenSpec store setup; archive does not. The Specify control
workspace and step registration are currently manual, and the wheel omits
the step package.

## Goals and boundaries

Reduce bootstrap to `pip install` + `local.yaml` + `specrunway init`, keeping
all writes inside the control checkout. Upstream binaries remain
prerequisites; the user does not type their commands. Vendor no upstream
Python packages beyond the pinned CLI tools. `init` must never touch a
business repository or run inside one.

## Decisions

- **Packaging**: move the step shim to `src/specrunway/step_package/`
  (`step.yml` + `__init__.py`) and include it as package data, so an
  installed wheel can pass its path to `specify workflow step add --dev`.
  The dev repository uses the same path (no duplicate copy).
- **`specrunway init`**:
  1. require and validate `local.yaml` at the control root
     (`local-yaml-missing` otherwise);
  2. resolve pinned `openspec` and `specify` via the existing tool resolver;
  3. call the adapter's idempotent store setup;
  4. if `.specify` is absent, run `specify init --here --force
     --non-interactive --ignore-agent-tools` with an explicit control cwd;
  5. run `specify workflow step add specrunway --dev <bundled step path>`;
  6. run `doctor` and surface findings; exit 1 on errors.
  Existing `.specify` is never regenerated, and a second `init` is a no-op.
- **Archive**: call the idempotent store setup before `openspec archive`, so
  users never register the Store manually.
- **Errors**: stable envelope codes for missing/invalid local config,
  missing upstream binaries, failed init, and failed step install; the
  message names the exact tool and installation hint.

## Implementation slices

- **L17**: packaging move; `init` command; archive setup; tests (idempotent
  init, fresh control, bundled step presence, archive auto-registration);
  runbook/README updates.

## Verification

Use a disposable control checkout with `local.yaml` and the pinned CLIs:
run `init` twice, assert exit 0, `.specify` presence, the installed step
directory containing `step.yml`, and Store registration. Build a wheel and
assert `step_package/step.yml` is present and `init` appears in `--help`.
Re-run archive against a temporarily unregistered Store. Record commands and
exit codes; run the full suite and strict validation.

## Risks and trade-offs

`specify init` writes an agent-integration scaffold; it is restricted to the
control checkout and skipped when already present. Upstream CLI flags are
pinned by the measured L01 contract; an unsupported version fails `init`
with the tool name rather than silently diverging.

# Proposal

## Why

Daily operation already uses only `specrunway`, but first use still requires
three upstream commands (`openspec store setup`, `specify init`, `specify
workflow step add`), and the published wheel does not contain the step shim,
so an installed user has no path to `--dev`. That friction is unacceptable
for a local release and makes the documented dogfood flow error-prone.

## What Changes

Implement source task L17: add an idempotent `specrunway init` that
validates the control checkout, registers the Store, initializes the Specify
workspace only inside the control checkout, installs the bundled
`specrunway` step from package data, and reports diagnostics. Ship the step
shim inside the wheel. Make archive registration idempotent. Update the
runbook so the only hand-written artifact is `local.yaml`.

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities

None. This change improves the existing `local-project` capability.

### Modified Capabilities

- `local-project`: Adds one-command control-checkout bootstrap and bundled
  step installation without requiring direct upstream CLI calls.

## Impact

Package data (step shim in the wheel), a new CLI subcommand, archive Store
registration, tests, and runbook/README. No service or v2 component.
Prerequisite: the archived v1 baseline (L01-L16).

# Spec Delta

## Purpose

Closes the bootstrap gap in the archived local-project baseline so an
installed user can prepare a control checkout without invoking upstream CLIs
directly.

## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: One-command control bootstrap
The CLI SHALL provide an idempotent `init` command that validates the
machine-only control configuration, registers the Store, initializes the
Specify workspace inside the control checkout, installs the bundled
SpecRunway step, and reports diagnostics.

#### Scenario: Fresh control checkout
- **WHEN** a user with `local.yaml` and pinned upstream tools runs `specrunway init`
- **THEN** the Store is registered, `.specify` exists, and the `specrunway` step is installed without any other upstream command typed by the user.

#### Scenario: Repeated init
- **WHEN** `specrunway init` runs again on an initialized control checkout
- **THEN** it succeeds without regenerating the Specify workspace or duplicating steps.

#### Scenario: Missing configuration
- **WHEN** `local.yaml` is absent or invalid
- **THEN** `init` fails with a stable code and does not write outside the control checkout.

### Requirement: Bundled step package
The installed distribution SHALL include the `specrunway` step shim so step installation works from a wheel without a source checkout.

#### Scenario: Wheel installation
- **WHEN** the wheel is installed in a fresh environment
- **THEN** the step metadata and handler are available as package data and `init` installs them.

### Requirement: Idempotent Store registration
Archive SHALL ensure the configured Store is registered before applying specification deltas.

#### Scenario: Unregistered Store at archive time
- **WHEN** the Store was not registered when the execution finished
- **THEN** archive registers it idempotently and proceeds, or fails with a clear upstream error without losing evidence.

=== openspec/specs/local-project/spec.md
# local-project Specification

## Purpose
Provides one locally installed command package and central configuration while preserving existing business repositories.

## Requirements

### Requirement: Standalone local invocation
The system SHALL provide its local CLI without requiring a network service, database, broker, account system, or team backend.

#### Scenario: Fresh local setup
- **WHEN** the required package and pinned external tools are installed
- **THEN** the CLI can locate its central configuration and run diagnostics locally.

### Requirement: Central tool configuration
The system SHALL keep tool initialization and machine-specific repository mappings in the central control workspace.

#### Scenario: Business repositories unchanged
- **WHEN** the coordinator is configured for two existing repositories
- **THEN** no tool initialization is required in their original checkouts.

### Requirement: Typed OpenSpec operations
The system SHALL invoke OpenSpec with explicit Store selection and argv arguments and SHALL reject unsupported critical response data.

#### Scenario: Invalid planning response
- **WHEN** OpenSpec returns malformed or unsupported critical JSON
- **THEN** the operation fails with a diagnostic and no implementation is accepted.

### Requirement: One-command control bootstrap
The CLI SHALL provide an idempotent `init` command that validates the
machine-only control configuration, registers the Store, initializes the
Specify workspace inside the control checkout, installs the bundled
SpecRunway step, and reports diagnostics.

#### Scenario: Fresh control checkout
- **WHEN** a user with `local.yaml` and pinned upstream tools runs `specrunway init`
- **THEN** the Store is registered, `.specify` exists, and the `specrunway` step is installed without any other upstream command typed by the user.

#### Scenario: Repeated init
- **WHEN** `specrunway init` runs again on an initialized control checkout
- **THEN** it succeeds without regenerating the Specify workspace or duplicating steps.

#### Scenario: Missing configuration
- **WHEN** `local.yaml` is absent or invalid
- **THEN** `init` fails with a stable code and does not write outside the control checkout.

### Requirement: Bundled step package
The installed distribution SHALL include the `specrunway` step shim so step installation works from a wheel without a source checkout.

#### Scenario: Wheel installation
- **WHEN** the wheel is installed in a fresh environment
- **THEN** the step metadata and handler are available as package data and `init` installs them.

### Requirement: Idempotent Store registration
Archive SHALL ensure the configured Store is registered before applying specification deltas.

#### Scenario: Unregistered Store at archive time
- **WHEN** the Store was not registered when the execution finished
- **THEN** archive registers it idempotently and proceeds, or fails with a clear upstream error without losing evidence.

# local-release Specification

## Purpose
Demonstrates that an independently installed local distribution satisfies every required v1 acceptance case and supports human operation.

## Requirements

### Requirement: Installed distribution acceptance
The local v1 release SHALL pass all V1-A01 through V1-A14 cases using the installed distribution and pinned upstream tools.

#### Scenario: Missing live-agent evidence
- **WHEN** the real agent profile has not completed the required two-repository demonstration
- **THEN** release remains blocked even when deterministic fixture tests pass.

### Requirement: Reproducible operational replays
The release SHALL retain normal, deliberate failure and repair, and abnormal recovery replays plus a backup and restore procedure.

#### Scenario: Fresh operator setup
- **WHEN** an implementer follows the documented installation and runbook in a new directory
- **THEN** the supported workflow and takeover procedures can be reproduced.

### Requirement: Portable contract evidence
Shared execution summaries SHALL retain stable IDs, schema versions, relative artifact references, and content digests without credentials or machine checkout paths.

#### Scenario: Portable data inspection
- **WHEN** the release fixture is exported for review
- **THEN** its shared metadata contains no secret or absolute machine checkout path.

# SpecRunway

Spec-driven execution across repositories.

SpecRunway coordinates one OpenSpec change that spans two or more existing Git
repositories. It freezes the approved plan and base commits, drives an ordered
per-repository implementation loop through a Specify workflow (`type:
specrunway`), validates agent results against trusted test evidence, enforces
repair budgets, gates plan and implementation review on local approval
receipts, and finishes at `ready_for_review`. Archiving is always explicit.

Status: local v1 implemented (source tasks L01-L15). Required acceptance
cases and evidence: `docs/ACCEPTANCE.md` and
`docs/evidence/05-release-local-v1.md`. No server, database, broker, account
system, or v2 component is required.

## Operate it

- `docs/RUNBOOK.md` — install, control checkout, plan, run, approve,
  resume/recover, repair, archive, backup, cleanup.
- Command surface: `specrunway doctor|plan|run|approve|resume|recover|status|archive`.
- `docs/examples/` — envelope, approval, manifest, local config, workflow.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check the initial handoff structure, not product behavior or post-archive CI."""
from pathlib import Path
import json, re, sys

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
active = sorted((root/'openspec/changes').glob('[0-9][0-9]-*'))
archived = sorted((root/'openspec/changes/archive').glob('*-[0-9][0-9]-*'))
changes = active + archived
expected = {'01','02','03','04','05','06','07','08'}
covered = set()
for change in changes:
    found = re.findall(r'(?:^|-)(\d{2})-', change.name)
    covered.update(value for value in found if value in expected)
assert covered == expected, f'Implementation change coverage incomplete: {sorted(covered)}'
seen = set()
requirements = scenarios = task_count = 0
for change in changes:
    required = ['proposal.md','design.md','tasks.md']
    if change in active:
        required.insert(0, '.openspec.yaml')
    for filename in required:
        assert (change/filename).is_file(), f'Missing {change.name}/{filename}'
    task_text = (change/'tasks.md').read_text()
    tasks = re.findall(r'^- \[([ xX])\] (\d+\.\d+) \[(L\d{2})\] (.+)$',task_text,re.M)
    assert tasks, f'No tracked source-linked tasks in {change.name}'
    assert len({t[1] for t in tasks}) == len(tasks), 'Duplicate task checkbox IDs'
    for marker,checkbox,source,description in tasks:
        seen.add(source); task_count += 1
        assert re.search(r'\bverify\b',description,re.I), f'No verification in {source}/{checkbox}'
    declared = set(re.findall(r'^- `([a-z0-9-]+)`: ',(change/'proposal.md').read_text(),re.M))
    specs = list((change/'specs').glob('*/spec.md'))
    assert declared == {p.parent.name for p in specs}, 'Proposal/spec capability mismatch'
    for spec in specs:
        text = spec.read_text()
        purpose = re.search(r'^## Purpose\s+(.+?)(?=^## )',text,re.M|re.S)
        assert purpose and len(purpose.group(1).strip())>=50, f'Short purpose in {spec}'
        blocks = re.split(r'^### Requirement: ',text,flags=re.M)[1:]
        assert blocks
        for block in blocks:
            head,body = block.split('\n',1)
            description = body.split('#### Scenario:',1)[0].strip()
            assert re.search(r'\b(SHALL|MUST)\b',description), f'Non-normative requirement: {head}'
            assert len(description)<=500, f'Overlong requirement: {head}'
            parts = re.split(r'^#### Scenario: ',body,flags=re.M)[1:]
            assert parts, f'No scenario: {head}'
            for part in parts:
                assert '- **WHEN** ' in part and '- **THEN** ' in part
            requirements += 1; scenarios += len(parts)
assert seen == {f'L{i:02d}' for i in range(1,19)}, f'Incorrect required source IDs: {seen}'
for p in root.rglob('*'):
    if not p.is_file() or any(x in p.parts for x in ['node_modules','.venv','.git']): continue
    if p.suffix in ['.md','.yaml','.json','.sh','.py']:
        assert not re.search(r'[\u3400-\u9fff]',p.read_text()), f'Non-English content in {p}'
print(json.dumps({'changes':len(changes),'active':len(active),'archived':len(archived),
                  'source_tasks':len(seen),'checkbox_tasks':task_count,
                  'requirements':requirements,'scenarios':scenarios,'result':'passed'}))
# Change 08 evidence: configurable, frozen test profiles

## Implemented (L18)

- `local.yaml` may declare `test_profiles: {name: {command: [argv...],
  cwd?: "<relative>", timeout_seconds?: int}}`. The schema rejects empty
  argv, absolute cwd, parent traversal, non-slug names, and non-positive
  timeouts; configured profiles override the built-in registry by name.
- `specrunway/testprofiles.py`: `TestProfile` now carries `cwd` and
  `timeout_seconds`; `freeze_test_profiles` resolves every profile referenced
  by the manifest and stores `command`/`cwd`/`timeout_seconds`/`config_digest`
  in `snapshot.test_profiles`; `profile_for_repo` prefers frozen data and
  falls back to the built-in `unit` profile for legacy snapshots.
- Freeze happens in `hub run` before any agent work; unknown profiles refuse
  execution. `local.yaml` edits after freeze do not affect the execution.
- Consumers now use the frozen profile and its relative cwd: run-repo trusted
  receipts, verify-round/repair-round, integration repair verification, the
  prompt's trusted `test_command`/`test_cwd`, and the archive final-matrix
  check.
- Examples/RUNBOOK show Go (`go test ./...` in a subdirectory) and
  kustomize/Helm (`bash scripts/validate_k8s_yaml.sh`) profiles.

## Verified

`tests/test_test_profiles.py` (5 tests, real git + fake agent):

1. Unsafe absolute/`..` cwd and an empty argv are rejected by config
   validation (`test-cwd`).
2. A repository whose tests live in `sub/` runs the frozen profile from the
   worktree subdirectory: the trusted receipt records
   `.../worktrees/repo-a/sub` and passes; the snapshot stores `cwd: "sub"`.
3. After freezing, changing the control command to a failing one leaves
   verification passing — the frozen argv is authoritative.
4. An unknown profile refuses freeze (`unknown-profile`).
5. A snapshot without `test_profiles` falls back to the built-in `unit`
   profile.

Full suite: `pytest -q` → 203 passed. `ruff check src tests` → clean.
`scripts/check_handoff.py` → L01-L18 coverage. `openspec validate --all
--strict` → valid.

Acceptance linkage: V1-A03 (profile validation), V1-A06 (trusted evidence),
V1-A07 (repair feedback uses the same trusted command).

input.content:
# Proposal

## Why

The v1 dogfood run exposed two onboarding costs that the one-command bootstrap
does not remove. A new user must still hand-write `local.yaml`, including
repository paths, remote identities, test profiles, and an integration profile,
before `specrunway init` can run. After bootstrap, the user must also author a
structured `request.md` by hand before `specrunway plan` can generate planning
artifacts. Both files encode machine wiring and change intent that the product
can collect or draft through a small guided flow.

## What Changes

Add source task L19: an interactive `specrunway wizard` that performs two
phases without adding a service or model dependency.

1. When the control checkout has no `local.yaml`, the wizard inspects existing
   Git checkouts, asks only for the missing wiring, writes the machine-only
   configuration, and runs the existing idempotent `init` flow.
2. When the control checkout is already configured, the wizard accepts a short
   natural-language change summary, asks a few bounded follow-up questions,
   maps task text to the configured repositories, composes `request.md` and a
   routing manifest, then invokes the existing `specrunway plan` path.

The wizard is deterministic and testable: it uses templates and Git inspection,
not a coding agent, for requirement drafting. It never runs implementation,
approval, or archive; those remain explicit commands.

Also fix the default manifest generation in `specrunway plan`: when no
`--manifest` is supplied it must route tasks to the repositories configured in
`local.yaml`, not to hardcoded `repo-a`/`repo-b` names.

## Capabilities

- `guided-onboarding`: Adds a resumable interactive wizard for control
  configuration and change-request drafting, with deterministic artifacts and
  explicit handoff to the existing plan command.

## Impact

New `specrunway/wizard.py`, a small bootstrap helper extraction, one CLI
subcommand, default-manifest routing changes in `planning.py`, tests, and
README/RUNBOOK updates. No schema version change, no new runtime dependency,
and no service or v2 component.

# Design

## Context

The archived v1 baseline already owns configuration validation, OpenSpec
planning, and control bootstrap. `specrunway init` requires a valid
`local.yaml`, and `specrunway plan` accepts either a complete manual plan or a
`request.md` plus optional routing manifest. The dogfood run showed that these
inputs, not the execution engine, are the first-use barrier.

This change is developer tooling for the control layer. It must not write to a
business checkout, infer an approval, or make planning success look like
implementation completion.

## Goals and boundaries

- Reduce first use to `pip install`, `specrunway wizard`, and a few answers.
- Keep every artifact deterministic, inspectable, and editable.
- Reuse `local.yaml` validation, `init`, and `plan`; do not duplicate their
  business rules.
- Support repeat use: a configured control checkout enters the request phase
  directly; `--reconfigure` explicitly re-opens the configuration phase.
- Do not call a coding agent while drafting a request. The configured agent is
  reserved for implementation after approval.
- Never invoke `run`, `approve`, `resume`, `recover`, or `archive` from the
  wizard.

## Decisions

### Command surface

Add one command, `specrunway wizard`. Options:

- `--root` (explicit control checkout), `--reconfigure`, `--json`;
- `--change`, `--description`, `--request`, `--manifest` for scripted or
  repeat runs;
- `--skip-init`, `--skip-plan` for diagnostics and tests.

Interactive prompts go to the selected output stream. In `--json` mode prompts
go to stderr and the final `specrunway/v1` envelope goes to stdout, so callers
can parse the result without losing the interview.

### Configuration phase

Triggered only when `local.yaml` is absent or `--reconfigure` is present.

- Store id defaults to `specrunway-store`; store path defaults to
  `<control>/openspec-store` and is resolved to an absolute path.
- Existing sibling Git checkouts are listed as discovery hints. The wizard
  accepts repository paths one at a time until an empty answer, resolves
  relative paths against the control root, rejects non-Git paths, derives the
  repository id from the directory name, and reads `remote.origin.url`.
- A missing origin is prompted explicitly; an invalid or remote-less checkout
  fails before writing.
- Test commands are collected per repository with a marker-based suggestion
  (`pytest`, `go test`, `npm test`, `cargo test`). A blank answer keeps the
  built-in `unit` fallback. Non-blank answers become `<repo>-unit` profiles.
- An integration command is collected once and becomes
  `specrunway-integration`, defaulting to the first repository's test command.
- The resulting mapping is validated with the existing `local.yaml` validator,
  written atomically, and then handed to the existing init flow. The wizard
  writes only inside the control checkout and the configured Store path.

### Request phase

- The change id defaults to a slug derived from the description and must pass
  the existing slug rule.
- The description supplies `Why` and `What Changes` defaults; the wizard asks
  bounded follow-up questions for context and acceptance, then asks for
  repository task text.
- Task ids are assigned deterministically in repository order (`T001`, ...).
  The wizard asks whether each later repository depends on the previous one so
  the manifest expresses only real ordering.
- Allowed paths and base ref are suggested from the checkout layout and current
  branch, then editable per repository.
- `request.md` is written under `<control>/requests/<change>.md`; the draft
  manifest is written under `.specrunway/requests/<change>.manifest.yaml`.
  Existing files are not overwritten without confirmation.
- The wizard calls `plan` with the generated request and manifest. It reports
  the change path and the next explicit commands; it does not execute them.

### Default manifest routing

`plan` without `--manifest` currently synthesizes `repo-a`/`repo-b`, which are
fixture names. Change it to use the repository ids, order, base refs, and
declared test/integration profiles from `local.yaml`, while retaining the
fixture-compatible split when the fixture declares those same ids. This makes
`specrunway plan --request request.md` usable in a real control checkout.

## Implementation slices

- **L19**: bootstrap helper extraction, `wizard.py`, CLI command, default
  manifest routing fix, tests, and operator documentation.

## Verification

Use disposable Git checkouts and a scripted prompt stream. Verify:

1. A bare control checkout receives a valid `local.yaml`, request, manifest,
   and planning invocation; the generated manifest uses declared repo ids.
2. A configured checkout skips configuration, preserves the existing file, and
   creates a second change request.
3. Blank task input, unknown repository paths, duplicate ids, and cancelled
   overwrite produce stable errors without partial artifacts.
4. `--json` keeps stdout parseable while prompts use stderr.
5. The full suite, `ruff`, strict OpenSpec validation, and
   `scripts/check_handoff.py` pass; record the commands and results under
   `docs/evidence/09-guided-onboarding.md`.

## Risks and trade-offs

The wizard is intentionally not a requirement-quality agent. It removes
structural friction and produces reviewable text; the operator still owns
intent, and the existing plan/approval gates remain authoritative. Suggested
commands may not match every repository; every suggestion is visible and
editable before the configuration is written.

# guided-onboarding Specification

## Purpose

Provides a deterministic interactive onboarding path that turns a control
directory and a short change description into validated SpecRunway inputs,
without requiring the operator to hand-author machine wiring or request files.

## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Guided control configuration

The CLI SHALL provide an interactive wizard that collects the missing control configuration, validates it, writes `local.yaml` atomically, and runs the existing idempotent init flow.

#### Scenario: Fresh control checkout
- **WHEN** a user runs `specrunway wizard` in a directory without `local.yaml` and supplies valid store, repository, test, and integration answers
- **THEN** the wizard writes a valid control configuration, initializes the Store and Specify workspace, and reports the planned change or the configuration-only result.

#### Scenario: Existing configuration
- **WHEN** a valid `local.yaml` already exists and the user runs the wizard without `--reconfigure`
- **THEN** the wizard preserves the file and proceeds to the request phase.

#### Scenario: Invalid repository input
- **WHEN** a supplied repository path is missing, is not a Git checkout, or has an unusable remote identity
- **THEN** the wizard fails with a stable error before writing configuration or planning artifacts.

#### Scenario: Overwrite refusal
- **WHEN** a generated request or manifest already exists and the operator declines replacement
- **THEN** the wizard leaves the existing files unchanged and does not plan.

### Requirement: Guided change request

The wizard SHALL derive change id, request sections, task text, and routing from a short description plus bounded follow-up answers, and SHALL hand the artifacts to the existing plan command.

#### Scenario: Request generation
- **WHEN** an operator supplies a description and task text for configured repositories
- **THEN** the wizard writes a structured request and manifest, assigns stable task ids in repository order, and invokes plan without starting implementation.

#### Scenario: Repeat use
- **WHEN** the operator runs the wizard again for a different change
- **THEN** the existing configuration is reused and a new request is created without re-running configuration prompts.

#### Scenario: No task text
- **WHEN** any participating repository receives no task text
- **THEN** the wizard refuses to write a manifest that lacks task routing.

#### Scenario: JSON mode
- **WHEN** `--json` is requested
- **THEN** interactive prompts use stderr and stdout contains only the final `specrunway/v1` envelope.

### Requirement: Configured default routing

When `plan` receives a request without an explicit manifest, it SHALL derive routing from the repositories and profiles declared in the control configuration.

#### Scenario: Real repository names
- **WHEN** a control checkout declares repositories other than the fixture names and runs plan without `--manifest`
- **THEN** the generated manifest uses those declared repository ids and order.

#### Scenario: Unknown task mapping
- **WHEN** the request task labels cannot be routed to the declared repositories
- **THEN** plan fails with the existing routing error instead of producing a fixture-name manifest.

"""Idempotent control bootstrap shared by ``init`` and the onboarding wizard."""

from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from .models import ValidationError
from .openspec_adapter import OpenSpecAdapter
from .toolresolvers import resolve_tool_bin


def initialize_control(control_root: Path, config: dict) -> dict:
    """Prepare Store, Specify workspace, and the bundled step inside *control_root*."""
    root = Path(control_root).resolve()
    openspec_bin = resolve_tool_bin(root, None, "openspec")
    specify_bin = resolve_tool_bin(root, None, "specify")
    store_path = Path(config["store"]["path"])
    store_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    adapter = OpenSpecAdapter(
        store_path=store_path,
        store_id=config["store"]["id"],
        openspec_bin=openspec_bin,
    )
    adapter.store_setup()

    specify_initialized = False
    if not (root / ".specify").is_dir():
        done = subprocess.run(
            [
                specify_bin,
                "init",
                "--here",
                "--force",
                "--non-interactive",
                "--ignore-agent-tools",
            ],
            cwd=str(root),
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=False,
            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        )
        if done.returncode != 0:
            raise ValidationError(
                "specify-init-failed",
                f"specify init failed (exit {done.returncode}): "
                f"{(done.stderr or done.stdout)[-400:]}",
            )
        specify_initialized = True

    step_path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "step_package"
    installed_step = root / ".specify" / "workflows" / "steps" / "specrunway" / "step.yml"
    step = None
    if not installed_step.is_file():
        step = subprocess.run(
            [specify_bin, "workflow", "step", "add", "specrunway", "--dev", str(step_path)],
            cwd=str(root),
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=False,
            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        )
    if step is not None and step.returncode != 0:
        raise ValidationError(
            "step-install-failed",
            f"specify step install failed (exit {step.returncode}): "
            f"{(step.stderr or step.stdout)[-400:]}",
        )

    return {
        "specify_initialized": specify_initialized,
        "step_package": str(step_path),
    }


__all__ = ["initialize_control"]

def _minimal_manifest(
    adapter: OpenSpecAdapter, change_id: str, task_texts: dict, config: dict
) -> dict:
    tasks = sorted(task_texts) or ["T001"]
    return _default_manifest(adapter, change_id, tasks, config, task_texts)


def _manual_manifest(
    adapter: OpenSpecAdapter, change_id: str, task_ids: list, config: dict
) -> dict:
    """Manual-plan routing over the repositories declared by the control checkout."""
    tasks = sorted(set(task_ids)) or ["T001"]
    return _default_manifest(adapter, change_id, tasks, config, {})


def _default_manifest(
    adapter: OpenSpecAdapter,
    change_id: str,
    tasks: list,
    config: dict,
    task_texts: dict,
) -> dict:
    repo_ids = list(config["repos"])
    selected = repo_ids[: max(1, min(len(tasks), len(repo_ids)))]
    chunks: list = []
    start = 0
    base_size, remainder = divmod(len(tasks), len(selected))
    for index in range(len(selected)):
        size = base_size + (1 if index < remainder else 0)
        chunks.append(tasks[start : start + size])
        start += size
    repos = []
    profiles = config.get("test_profiles") or {}
    for index, repo_id in enumerate(selected):
        entry = config["repos"][repo_id]
        repo_path = Path(entry["path"])
        profile = f"{repo_id}-unit" if f"{repo_id}-unit" in profiles else "unit"
        repos.append(
            {
                "repo_id": repo_id,
                "base_ref": _repo_base_ref(repo_path),
                "task_ids": chunks[index] or [tasks[min(index, len(tasks) - 1)]],
                "depends_on": [selected[index - 1]] if index else [],
                "allowed_paths": _repo_allowed_paths(repo_path),
                "test_profile": profile,
            }
        )
    integration_profile = next(
        iter(config.get("integration_profiles") or {}), "specrunway-integration"
    )
    manifest = {
        "api_version": "specrunway/v1",
        "store_uid": spec_uid(str(adapter.store_path)),
        "change_id": change_id,
        "change_uid": spec_uid(change_id),
        "repo_order": [repo["repo_id"] for repo in repos],
        "repos": repos,
        "acceptance": [
            {
                "id": f"AC{index:02d}",
                "requirement": task_texts.get(task_id, f"{task_id} completes verification."),
                "verifies": [task_id],
            }
            for index, task_id in enumerate(tasks, start=1)
        ],
        "integration_profile": integration_profile,
        "completion_policy": "merged_commits",
        "budget": {"repo_max_attempts": 3, "integration_max_repairs": 2, "total_minutes": 120},
    }
    validate_manifest(manifest, known_profiles=set(profiles) | {"unit"})
    return manifest


def _repo_base_ref(repo_path: Path) -> str:
    import subprocess

    for args in (("symbolic-ref", "--short", "-q", "HEAD"), ("rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD")):
        done = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "-C", str(repo_path), *args],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=False,
        )
        value = done.stdout.strip()
        if done.returncode == 0 and value and value != "HEAD":
            return value
    return "main"


def _repo_allowed_paths(repo_path: Path) -> list:
    candidates = [
        "src",
        "tests",
        "docs",
        "scripts",
        "cmd",
        "internal",
        "pkg",
        "controllers",
        "api",
    ]
    found = [name for name in candidates if (Path(repo_path) / name).is_dir()]
    return found or ["src", "tests"]
